title: 第515章 欺我青云剑宗无人第514章 奉陪到底
content_zh:
第515章欺我青云剑宗无人！
随着齐王一声令下，天穹之上那数十道恐怖的气息同时爆发！
轰！轰！轰！
一道道惊天动地的气息冲天而起，搅动风云，撕裂天穹！
那数十位通天境强者、数位剑皇级存在，同时释放出自己的气势，如同数十座火山同时喷发，恐怖的能量波动席卷四方，让整片天地都在剧烈颤抖！
“领命！”
“遵命！”
“杀！”
一道道低沉而充满杀意的声音响起，紧接着，那数十道身影同时动了！
他们没有保留，一出手就是全力！
数十道恐怖的攻击，如同漫天流星般朝着周尘和梅临雪轰然落下！
每一道攻击，都足以轻易击杀一名通天境以下的武者！
数十道攻击叠加在一起，那威力简直毁天灭地！
“师尊小心！”
周尘脸色大变，体内灵力疯狂运转，太初剑意冲天而起，化作一道璀璨的剑幕挡在身前！
梅临雪也是面色凝重，手中长剑挥洒，一道道凌厉的剑气纵横交错，在她和周尘周围形成了一道密不透风的剑网！
轰隆隆。
刹那间，天摇地动！
狂暴的能量余波向着四面八方疯狂扩散，所过之处，地面皲裂，山石崩碎，就连空气都被震得发出刺耳的尖啸！
“噗！”

周尘身体剧震，一口鲜血喷涌而出，整个人连连后退了七八步，才勉强稳住身形。
他的剑幕，在第一波攻击下就出现了裂纹！
而那些攻击，才刚刚开始！
“周尘！”
梅临雪脸色一变，连忙挥出一道剑气替他挡下了紧随而来的第二波攻击，可她自己却因此露出了破绽，被一道隐藏在暗处的剑皇偷袭，肩头瞬间被划开一道伤口！
鲜血染红了她的白衣，触目惊心！
“师尊！”
周尘眼睛瞬间红了，体内灵力疯狂燃烧，就要冲上去拼命！
可梅临雪却一把按住了他的肩膀。
“别冲动，为师没事。”
可她那微微颤抖的手臂，却暴露了她此刻的状态。
她虽然战力冠绝青州，可面对数十位通天境强者、数位剑皇的围攻，她也撑不了多久！
更何况，她还要分心保护周尘！
而在下方，青云剑宗的弟子们看到这一幕，心都碎了。
他们眼睁睁看着宗主和周尘被围攻，却什么都做不了！
不是他们不想帮忙，而是他们根本帮不上忙！
content_en:
Chapter 515: There is no one from the Qingyun Sword Sect who bullies me!
Following King Qi's order, dozens of terrifying auras erupted in the sky at the same time!
boom! boom! boom!
Earth-shaking auras soared into the sky, stirring up the wind and clouds and tearing apart the sky!
Those dozens of Heaven-reaching powerhouses and several Sword King-level beings simultaneously released their momentum, like dozens of volcanoes erupting at the same time. Terrifying energy fluctuations swept across all directions, causing the entire world to tremble violently!
"Take orders!"
"As you command!"
"Kill!"
A series of low and murderous voices sounded, and then, dozens of figures moved at the same time!
They didn't hold anything back, and they went all out when they took action!
Dozens of terrifying attacks suddenly fell towards Zhou Chen and Mei Linxue like meteors all over the sky!
Every attack is enough to easily kill a warrior below the Tongtian realm!
When dozens of attacks are stacked together, the power is simply devastating!
"Master, be careful!"
Zhou Chen's face changed drastically, and the spiritual power in his body was running wildly. Taichu's sword intention soared into the sky, turning into a brilliant sword curtain to block him!
Mei Linxue also had a serious look on her face, and she swung her long sword in her hand. The sharp sword energy criss-crossed, forming an airtight sword network around her and Zhou Chen!
Rumble.
In an instant, the earth shook!
The aftermath of the violent energy spread crazily in all directions. Wherever it passed, the ground cracked, rocks shattered, and even the air was shaken to the point of screaming!
"Poof!"
Zhou Chen's body shook violently, and a mouthful of blood spurted out. He took seven or eight steps back before he could barely stabilize his body.
His sword screen cracked under the first wave of attacks!
And those attacks have just begun!
"Zhou Chen!"
Mei Linxue's expression changed, and she quickly swung out a sword energy to block the second wave of attacks that followed. However, she herself was exposed and was attacked by a Sword King hidden in the dark. A wound was instantly opened on her shoulder!
The blood stained her white clothes red, which was shocking!
"Master!"
Zhou Chen's eyes turned red instantly, and the spiritual power in his body burned crazily, and he was about to rush forward and fight for his life!
But Mei Linxue held his shoulders.
"Don't be impulsive. It's okay as a teacher."
But her slightly trembling arms revealed her current state.
Although her combat prowess is the best in Qingzhou, she can't hold out for long when faced with the siege of dozens of Tongtian Realm experts and several Sword Emperors!
What's more, she has to distract herself from protecting Zhou Chen!
Below, the disciples of Qingyun Sword Sect were heartbroken when they saw this scene.
They watched helplessly as the sect leader and Zhou Chen were besieged, but they could do nothing!
It’s not that they don’t want to help, it’s that they can’t help at all!
